openalgo._comment: Point OPENALGO_API_KEY at a dry-run / analyzer-mode OpenAlgo instance only. This server exposes place_order/cancel_all_orders — never point it at a live-money instance. Set OPENALGO_API_KEY in your shell environment before launching Claude Code; it is intentionally not hardcoded here.

trading-db-readonly._comment: Read-only inspection of a COPY of the trading DB, never the live prod file. Before use: run `python engine/scripts/refresh_dev_db.py` (once Phase 2's dev/prod split lands) or manually `sqlite3 engine/data/trades.db ".backup engine/data/dev_copy.db"` to produce engine/data/dev_copy.db. Do not point this at engine/data/trades.db directly.
